scope: Read-only full validation; eval/inference_mode CPU forward only; no fitting, backward, optimizer, training, activation or test-set selection

definitions.categories: Each GT belongs to exactly one of the five categories; see attribute_failures docstring
definitions.localization: Any geometrically valid raw anchor IoU >=0.50 regardless of confidence: oracle upper bound, not recall
definitions.wrong_class: No localized raw anchor has the correct argmax class
definitions.confidence: Correct-class raw localization exists but none passes raw floor .001 and frozen calibrated threshold
definitions.decoder_matching: Eligible correct-class raw localization lost through top600, classwise NMS .5, final100 or one-to-one competition
definitions.confusion: Class predicted by highest-IoU raw anchor, conditional on IoU >=.50; separate from exclusive counts
definitions.losses: Image-mean forward snapshots of BOTH BCE and focal; not historical epoch losses or causal ablation

validation_metrics.ap_definition: 101-point interpolated precision at IoU 0.50, class-aware one-to-one matching
